full_prompt_en: A square expressive painting shows a woman standing alone beneath a bright red umbrella on a rain soaked city plaza. She is placed just to the right of center in the middle distance, seen mostly as a dark silhouette with a red skirt falling below a black coat. The umbrella tilts toward the left, its saturated curved canopy sheltering her head and shoulders. Two tall black wading birds stand in the near left foreground, their long curved necks and thin legs reflected faintly in the wet paving. The plaza opens wide between them and the woman. Its white and gray surface is cut by dark horizontal seams and pools of water that mirror the red umbrella as a vertical streak reaching toward the lower edge. Behind her, vague black and gray building forms rise through mist; a narrow pale opening in the center left suggests a receding street. Small touches of red glow near the distant horizon, echoing the umbrella without competing with it. Rain softens the background, while the foreground retains scuffed paint, thin scratches, and loose black marks. Diffuse daylight from the cloudy sky washes the center to pale silver, and deeper charcoal shadow gathers along the sides. A few peach tones warm the far haze. The single red accent is vivid against the nearly monochrome setting, giving the quiet scene a sense of longing and movement. The painting feels atmospheric and cinematic, balancing an isolated figure, dark birds, and a broad reflective ground.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形表现性绘画描绘一位女子撑亮红伞独自站在雨水浸湿的城市广场。她位于中景中央略右，大部分是深色剪影，黑外套下露出红裙。雨伞向左倾，饱和弧形伞面遮住头肩。两只高挑的黑色涉禽立在近处左前景，弯曲长颈与细腿在湿铺地上留下淡影。广场在它们与女子之间宽阔展开。白灰地面被深色水平接缝与积水切开，水把红伞映成伸向下缘的竖向红色带。她身后，模糊的黑灰建筑形体在薄雾中升起；中左一处狭窄浅色开口暗示后退街道。远处地平线附近的小红点呼应雨伞，却不争抢焦点。雨把背景柔化，前景仍保留擦损颜料、细刮痕和松散黑笔痕。阴天漫射光把中央洗成浅银色，两侧聚起更深炭灰阴影。少量桃色温暖远处薄雾。唯一红色重音在近乎单色环境里鲜亮，让安静场景带思念与运动感。绘画充满空气感和电影感，平衡孤单人物、深色鸟与宽广反光地面。
style_prompt_en: Expressive mixed media painting uses a nearly monochrome field of charcoal, silver gray, white, and misted black, punctuated by one strong crimson accent. A compact dark focal form sits in a broad reflective space, with small silhouetted marks placed asymmetrically near the foreground. Wet surfaces convert the accent into a long broken vertical echo; thin horizontal seams keep the ground plane legible. Background structures dissolve into fog through rubbed edges, dry scuffs, and diluted pigment. Light is soft and overcast, brightening the open center while the perimeter holds heavier shadow. Rough scraped texture and a few fine scratches remain visible through smooth atmospheric passages. A small warmth in the pale distance offsets the cool gray field. The result feels cinematic, solitary, and quietly emotional, with disciplined color and open space doing most of the work.
style_prompt_zh: 表现性混合媒介绘画以炭灰、银灰、白与雾黑构成近乎单色的画域，只有一处强烈深红重音。紧凑深色焦点立在宽广反光空间里，前景少量剪影痕迹不对称分布。潮湿表面把重音转成修长断续的竖向回声，细水平接缝使地面平面可辨。背景结构通过揉擦边缘、干刮痕与稀释颜料溶入薄雾。光柔和阴沉，照亮开放中央，外围保持较重阴影。粗糙刮擦肌理和几道细痕在平滑空气感区域中仍可见。远处浅色里的少量暖意抵消冷灰主调。整体有电影感、孤独而安静动情，严格用色和开放空间承担主要表达。
theme_en: Woman under a red umbrella on a rainy plaza with two black wading birds
theme_zh: 雨中广场上红伞下的女子与两只黑色涉禽
name: Helen Cottle
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
